Container.Name: DnD_Session_Engine_V1
Container.Overview: Automatic D&D Session Transcriber, Summarizer, and Google Docs Multi-Tab Engine powered by Google Gemini 2.5/3.8 Flash.

Config.Name: App Directory
Config.Description: Host path containing service_account.json and dynamic script files.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: API Key for Google Gemini Studio

Config.Name: Gemini Model
Config.Description: Gemini model identifier (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-3.5-pro)

Config.Name: Campaign Folders
Config.Description: Comma-separated Google Drive Folder IDs of campaign root folders to watch.

Config.Name: Check Interval (Seconds)
Config.Description: Polling interval to check Google Drive folders for new audio.
